message-thread__error: Your message couldn't be sent. Please try again.
captcha__load-error: The verification check couldn't load. Disable content blockers or try another browser.
auth-login__intro: See your orders, delivery dates and invoices.
auth-login__intro--claim: Sign in to save your order to your account.
auth-register__intro: Track your deliveries, see invoices, and reorder in a couple of taps.
claim-page__pending: Adding this order to your account…
claim-page__error-body: It may have already been used. If you saved this order before, it's in My orders.
page-meta__description--home: Screened topsoil, garden blend, compost, fill dirt and sand delivered by the yard. Live prices for your ZIP code and real delivery dates.
landing-hero__title: Topsoil, compost and fill, dumped right where you need it.
landing-hero__intro: Order by the cubic yard and see your delivered price for your ZIP code before you buy. We send the truck from the nearest yard that has it.
landing-steps__step-body--1: Choose what you need and how many yards. Not sure? The calculator turns length × width × depth into yards.
landing-steps__step-body--2: Your ZIP code tells us which yard is closest and has it in stock, and which trucks are free on your date. The price includes every truckload.
landing-steps__step-title--3: We dump it where you want
landing-steps__step-body--3: Tell us the spot (driveway, side yard, on a tarp) and the driver drops it there. No need to be home if the spot is clear.
landing-cta__body: Get your delivered price in about a minute.
settings-page__profile-hint: Need to change your name or email? Call or text us and we'll update it.
settings-page__language-hint: Used for this site on this device. Emails follow the language you ordered in.
settings-page__logout-hint: Signed in on a shared computer? Log out when you're done.
auth-login__error--rate-limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
auth-forgot__intro: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth-forgot__sent: If there's an account for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 2 hours.
auth-forgot__sent-hint: Don't see it? Check your spam folder, or make sure that's the email you signed up with.
auth-forgot__error--rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a while and try again.
auth-forgot__error--generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth-reset__done: Your password is changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth-reset__invalid: This reset link doesn't work anymore. Links expire after 2 hours and can only be used once.
auth-reset__error--generic: Your password couldn't be changed. Please try again.
auth-login__error--passkey-cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Sign in again to retry.
auth-login__error--passkey: Your passkey couldn't be verified. Sign in again to retry.
passkey-setup__intro: This account requires a passkey. Save one now; from then on you'll sign in with your password and then the passkey.
passkey-setup__step--2: When your browser or password manager (e.g. Bitwarden) asks, save it there.
passkey-setup__name-hint: Just for you, to tell your passkeys apart.
passkey-setup__error--cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed before it finished. Try again.
passkey-setup__error--generic: The passkey couldn't be saved. Try again.
passkey-manager__intro: Passkeys saved to your account on this site.
passkey-manager__intro--required: Your account requires a passkey after your password. Add a second one (e.g. your phone) as a backup.
passkey-manager__error--last: Your account requires a passkey, so the last one can't be removed. Add another first.
account-dialog__title: My orders needs a free account
account-dialog__body: Your account keeps every delivery in one place, so you never have to dig through emails.
account-dialog__perk--1: Every order with its delivery date and status
account-dialog__perk--2: Invoices for what was actually delivered
account-dialog__perk--3: Reorder the same material to the same spot in two taps
account-dialog__sign-in: I have an account, sign in
account-dialog__note: You don't need an account to order. You can add a past order to your account with the link in its confirmation email.
account-overview__unread: You have {count} new reply. | You have {count} new replies.
account-overview__load-error: Your orders couldn't be loaded. Please refresh to try again.
account-empty__body: Order while signed in and it shows up here. Ordered before you had an account? Use the link in your confirmation email to add it.
account-order__messages-intro: Ask anything about this delivery. We get an email and reply here.
account-order__messages-placeholder: e.g. Can the driver dump it closer to the garage?
account-order__requested: Requested for {date}. We'll confirm the date with you.
page-meta__description--order: Pick your material and yards, enter your ZIP code and see your delivered price and next open date right away.
landing-zip__intro: Enter your ZIP code to check.
landing-zip__error: We couldn't check right now. Try again, or call us.
landing-zip__result-title--contact: We go there by special request
landing-zip__result-body--serve: Order online and see your price and delivery date right away.
landing-zip__result-body--contact: Access or distance needs a closer look. Send us a request and we'll quote it.
landing-zip__result-body--outside: We don't normally deliver there, but tell us about the job and we'll see what we can do.
landing-products__intro: Prices are per cubic yard, loaded at the yard. Delivery is priced per truckload by distance; your ZIP code shows the exact total.
landing-products__load-error: Prices couldn't be loaded right now. You can still
landing-delivery__body--base: Covers the first {miles} miles from the yard, then {perMile} a mile.
landing-delivery__body--loads: Our trucks carry 6 to 14 yards. Each product rides in its own load, and you see every load in your quote.
landing-delivery__body--rush: Rush deliveries are possible when a truck is free. The order form shows the next open date.
landing-policies__card-body--access: A dump truck needs about 10 ft of width, 14 ft of overhead clearance and firm ground. Watch for low wires and soft lawns.
landing-policies__card-body--amount: One cubic yard covers about 100 sq ft at 3 inches deep, or 80 sq ft at 4 inches. The order form has a calculator.
landing-policies__card-body--days: Trucks run six days a week. Pick morning or afternoon if it matters; we'll confirm the day before.
landing-policies__card-body--special: Contractor quantities, steep or tight access, or a ZIP code outside our map? Send a special request and we'll quote it by hand.
order-header__intro--delivery: Tell us where and what. Your price and delivery date update as you go.
order-header__intro--callback: Big job, tricky access, or outside our area? Tell us about it and we'll call, text or email you back with a quote.
order-draft__restored: Picked up where you left off.
order-location__zip-hint: Your ZIP code sets the delivery price and which yard it ships from.
order-location__status--serve-no-city: We deliver to this ZIP code.
order-location__status-body--contact: We deliver there, but the access or distance needs a closer look, so we quote it by hand.
order-location__status-body--outside: We don't usually deliver to this ZIP code. Send us a special request and we'll let you know what's possible.
order-products__intro: Priced per cubic yard. Each product comes in its own truckload.
order-products__load-error: The product list couldn't be loaded.
order-products__out-of-stock: {product} is out of stock at the yards near you right now. You can still order and we'll call you about timing.
order-calculator__intro: Measure the area and how deep you want it. We round up to whole yards.
order-calculator__result--empty: Fill in all three to see yards.
order-calculator__hint: Topsoil and compost settle: add about 10% for new beds. Lawns: 1–2 in top-dressing, 4–6 in for new grass.
order-date__intro: Trucks run Monday to Saturday. We'll confirm the day before.
order-date__full-title: Our trucks are booked that day
order-date__full-body: The first day with a free truck is {date}. You can still ask for this date and we'll try to fit you in.
order-date__full-body--no-date: Nothing's free in the next few weeks. Send the order anyway and we'll call you with a date.
order-date__rush-body: Delivery today or tomorrow adds a {fee} rush fee.
order-placement__title: Where should the driver dump it?
order-placement__placeholder: e.g. Left side of the driveway, on the tarp. Gate code 1234. Watch for the sprinkler heads.
order-placement__tip--1: The truck needs about 10 ft wide and 14 ft high of clear space, on firm ground.
order-placement__tip--2: A tarp under the pile makes cleanup on driveways much easier.
order-placement__tip--3: We can't drive on lawns, septic fields or soft ground.
order-contact__notes-placeholder--delive: Project details, best time to call…
order-contact__notes-placeholder--callba: What you need, how much, access details, timing, and the best way to reach you.
order-consent__contact: I agree to be contacted by call, text or email about this order. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out of texts.
order-consent__marketing: Optional: send me occasional seasonal deals by text or email.
order-consent__marketing-promise: A few times a year, never more. Unsubscribe anytime.
order-quote__empty--zip: Enter your ZIP code to see delivery.
order-quote__empty--products: Pick a product to see your price.
order-quote__error: The price couldn't be calculated right now. You can still send the order.
order-quote__loads: Comes in {count} truckload. | Comes in {count} truckloads.
order-quote__note--delivery-fee: Delivery is {fee} per load for the first {miles} miles from the yard, then {perMile} a mile.
order-quote__note--confirm: We'll confirm the date and final price by phone or text.
order-quote__special-body: Leave your details and we'll get back to you with a price, usually within a business day.
order-quote__callback-body: Leave a note and we'll get back to you, usually within a business day. Prefer to talk now?
order-quote__no-payment: No payment now. You pay once we confirm the delivery.
order-confirmation__body--delivery: We'll call or text to confirm delivery on {date} and where to drop it.
order-confirmation__body--callback: We'll get back to you as soon as we can.
order-confirmation__plan-note--no_capaci: That day is tight for our trucks, so we may suggest another date when we call.
order-confirmation__plan-note--out_of_st: Part of your order is out of stock right now. We'll call you about timing.
order-confirmation__total-note: Material and delivery. Final price confirmed when we confirm your delivery.
order-confirmation__claim-body: Create a free account to track this order, see your invoice and reorder in two taps. The link is also in your confirmation email.
order-errors__phone--required: Leave a phone number so we can reach you.
order-errors__consent--required: Please check the box so we can contact you about this order.
order-errors__date--no-delivery: We don't deliver on Sundays. Pick another day.
order-errors__notes--required: Tell us a bit about what you need.
order-errors__rate-limited: Too many requests from this connection. Please call or text {phone}.
order-errors__generic: Something went wrong sending your order. Please try again or call {phone}.
